title: Fix the express shipments board
prompt: The dispatch board should list every warehouse with its express shipments, and warehouses with none should still show up. Instead, those warehouses disappear. Find the bug and fix `solve(warehouses, shipments)`.
rules: A shipment belongs to the warehouse with the same `warehouse_id`. Only shipments whose `service_level` is exactly `express` are listed.
Every warehouse appears: once per express shipment, or once with `shipment_id`, `sku` and `quantity` missing if it has none.
hints: Which rows does the `filter` remove? Look at a warehouse whose shipments are all standard, and at one with no shipments.
After a left join, a warehouse with no match has NULL in `service_level`, and `NULL == "express"` isn't true, so the filter drops it.
The fix belongs in or before the join, not after it: narrow only the shipments, so every warehouse still gets its row.
explanation: The filter runs after the left join, so it removes warehouses too. A warehouse whose shipments are all standard keeps only standard rows, which the filter drops, and a warehouse with no shipments has NULL `service_level`, which the filter also drops. The express rule should only decide which shipments match. Put it in the join: `w.join(s, (F.col("w.warehouse_id") == F.col("s.warehouse_id")) & (F.col("s.service_level") == "express"), "left")`, or filter first: `warehouses.join(shipments.filter(F.col("service_level") == "express"), on="warehouse_id", how="left")`. Either keeps every warehouse.
